T: Play the hit song. Then dinner.
D: Two small-town Icelandic musicians get the chance of a lifetime to represent their country at Eurovision.
P: Serve the snacks when Fire Saga takes the stage in Edinburgh.
S: Icelandic-style hot dogs with crispy fried onions, raw onion, sweet mustard and remoulade in soft buns.
Smoked trout on rye crispbread with crème fraîche, dill and pickled cucumber, a fishing village plate.
M: Lars's dad Erick at the family table in Húsavík

Lamb shoulder slow roasted with thyme and garlic until it falls apart, with Icelandic sugar-glazed baby potatoes, buttered peas and a red wine gravy. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and 4 crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender and peel. Melt 80g sugar in a pan until golden, add 40g butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml stock. Serve with buttered peas.
W: the little elf houses Sigrit leaves gifts at

Tangy skyr whipped with cream cheese and honey over a crunchy oat and butter crumble, topped with a warm blueberry and crowberry-style compote. Mix 80g rolled oats, 60g plain flour, 50g brown sugar and 60g melted butter, spread on a tray and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden. Cool and crumble. Beat 400g skyr or thick Greek yoghurt with 150g cream cheese and 3 tbsp honey until smooth. Simmer 250g blueberries with 2 tbsp sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes. Layer crumble, skyr and compote in 4 glasses and chill 1 hour.
K: Sparkling wine topped up with elderflower and soda, for when everyone joins in the sing-along.

s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts. Put in 8 hot dog buns with diced raw onion, 60g crispy fried onions, sweet mustard and 100g remoulade or tartare. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Spread 16 rye crispbreads with 150g crème fraîche. Top with 250g flaked smoked trout, thin pickled cucumber and dill. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
